question: given the corpus's TRUE bond classes, how many complexes can the decoder's _assemble_mol turn into a sanitized RDKit molecule?  This is the ceiling on any checkpoint.
method: tmQM BO shards -> heavy-atom graph -> bo_to_bond_class -> YuelBondBondDecoder._assemble_mol(cloud, true_bonds).  No model, no GPU, no sampling: the head is replaced by the answer.

before_the_fix.note: the pre-T83 chain, re-run on the same bond classes.  Every one of its repairs was `kekulize_demoted_all`, and that demotion was a no-op on an already-stripped molecule, so the 'repair' was the aromaticity loss itself.

reference_smiles_agreement.note: the pre-fix chain demoted EVERY aromatic bond on the same molecules, so its delta was -reference for all of them; the delta here is what the ring-local repair recovers

pyrrole_nitrogen.note: the fix is applied only to the subset that has such an N, so 'clean_after' is comparable to the failed count of the same subset, not to n_complexes

measured_rdkit_kekulize_behaviour.rule: even ring size kekulizes, odd ring size does not
measured_rdkit_kekulize_behaviour.consequence: the demotion targets exactly the rings RDKit handles and never touches the odd rings that fail
